results.title: Dickinson County Geographic Data Layers
results.description:
Overview

This collection of geographic data layers provides comprehensive cadastral, administrative, and infrastructure information for Dickinson County, Kansas, and surrounding regions. It encompasses various types of spatial data including boundaries, parcels, land use, zoning, transportation, voter precincts, and emergency services.

Feature Layers
  • Cadastral Layers: Includes Cadastral_Anno_Point for detailed annotation points, Cadastral_Line covering various boundary lines such as parcel, easement, subdivision, and township lines, and multiple polygon layers including CountyPoly, CorpPoly, LotPoly, SubBlockPoly, SubPoly, SectionPoly, TaxUnitPoly, PolTwpPoly (Political Township), and GeoTwpPoly (Geographical Township) representing administrative and land divisions.
  • Parcel and Property Data: Features ParcelPolyDKBasemap and CertifiedParcels2024, CertifiedParcels2025, CertifiedParcels2026 which provide detailed polygon data on land parcels including parcel identification numbers, ownership information, and property area.
  • Land Use and Zoning: LandUse layer describes land use types and agricultural crop information. ZoningMerged layer provides zoning areas including conditional use permits relevant to municipalities within the county.
  • Transportation Infrastructure: Includes RoadPoly for road polygon features, RailroadPoly for railroad polygons, RoadCenterline which gives detailed road centerline attributes including names, classifications, directions, and status, and Road Alias table providing alternative road names and aliases.
  • Voter and Emergency Service Boundaries: VoterPoly depicts voter precinct boundaries within the region. ESB and ESZ layers outline emergency services boundaries and zones. OOC_FIRERESPONSE provides fire response area data.
  • Addressing: The AddressPoints layer contains point features with detailed addressing attributes, including steward information and location types, supporting emergency response and property location purposes.
  • Parcel Points: ParcelPoint layer provides point representation of parcel locations with identifiers.
Geographic Coverage

The data primarily covers Dickinson County, Kansas, with some layers extending to adjacent counties and encompassing various municipal boundaries and townships within this area.

Use Cases
  • Land and property management, including parcel identification and ownership tracking.
  • Urban planning and zoning regulation.
  • Transportation planning and road network management.
  • Emergency service planning and coordination, including fire response and service boundaries.
  • Voter precinct management and electoral planning.
  • Geospatial analysis for government agencies and related stakeholders.
results.snippet: Comprehensive geographic data for Dickinson County, Kansas, including cadastral boundaries, parcels, land use, zoning, transportation networks, voter precincts, and emergency response areas.
